profile_text: Based in Düsseldorf, Germany, this catering and event services company provides a range of culinary experiences, from customized menus to full-scale event planning. With a focus on delivering high-quality food and exceptional service, it has established itself as a go-to partner for events in the region. Despite a recent decline in employee numbers, the company remains a key player in the accommodation and food service sector, with a strong reputation for tailored culinary solutions.
